text: こどもの　トレーナー　とはいえ　パワー　だけでなく　テクニックも　みがいてるな！

structure.jp: こどもの　トレーナー　とはいえ
パワー　だけでなく　テクニックも
structure.en: not just power but technique too

patterns.name: 〜とはいえ
patterns.span: トレーナー　とはいえ
patterns.explanation: とはいえ means 'even though that's true', and what follows goes against what you'd expect. こどもの　トレーナー　とはいえ = 'child Trainer though you are'.

patterns.name: 〜だけでなく
patterns.span: パワー　だけでなく　テクニックも
patterns.explanation: AだけでなくBも means 'not only A but B too'. パワー　だけでなく　テクニックも = 'not just power but technique too'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on or has been kept up; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. みがいてる = 'have been polishing'.
